fuse.source_tree_scope: src/vigil_fuse Python and JSON files plus pyproject.toml
fuse.source_tree_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted relative path, NUL, file bytes, NUL

selection_protocol.purpose: Qualitative scan of four independently selected, previously unscanned embedded and IoT repositories using the current FUSE build. Repositories were selected for architecture diversity before examining FUSE output. This is not a representative accuracy benchmark.
selection_protocol.interpretation: Pinned shallow public repository snapshots scanned with the generic profile and default supported-file selection. Static signals require human review; no builds, device tests, or dependency advisory database checks were run.
